rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi/compound adjective qualifying durgā; spans from akāra to kṣakāra
compound: durga-ārtti-nāśinī, one who destroys the distress of difficulties

items.question: What sonic extent and salvific function characterize the goddess Durgā?
premises: Durgā extends from the sound a to the sound kṣa.
Durgā destroys the distress of difficulties.
items.inference: Durgā embodies the complete range of sounds and removes the suffering of difficulties.
uncertainties: The first member of durgārttināśinī may be parsed as durga or durgā; taken here as difficulty-distress.
items.plain_english: Durgā, extending from the sound 'a' to 'kṣa', is the destroyer of the distress of difficulties.
